# Verdaca

> A governed AI decision workflow. A question goes through a three-role, model-backed deliberation loop and every run writes a hashed JSON receipt. Early: no users or customers yet.

Verdaca is built as ports and adapters: every external dependency sits behind a port contract checked by shared no-waiver contract suites. Two swaps are proven by those suites today: memory (Mem0 ↔ Letta) and compaction (LLMLingua ↔ in-tree). Other swaps are WIP.

## What runs today

- Deliberation loop: a producer (Claude Haiku 4.5) drafts; a reviewer (Claude Sonnet 5.5) writes a counterargument from the question and evidence alone, then critiques the draft; a synthesizer (Claude Haiku 4.5) returns a typed outcome: answer, clarify, abstain or escalate. One backtrack allowed; errors fail closed to escalate.
- Receipt: each run writes JSON with evidence, draft, critique, diff, outcome, state log, and per-call model, tokens, cost and stop reason. Hashed (SHA-256), not signed.
- How it runs: from a script (`scripts/live/deliberate_live.py`) or as an MCP tool (`verdaca_deliberate`), called once from Claude Desktop.
- Recorded runs: three on 2026-10-01, all on the same question; each cost about $0.03 ($0.026149, $0.030744, $0.031389). Receipts: https://github.com/verdaca/VERDACA/tree/main/docs/receipts
- Auth-first gateway: OIDC/JWT identity, replay protection, per-key budgets via LiteLLM virtual keys. Tested against a local OIDC validator; one manual Auth0 run in June 2026, with no committed log. The gateway does not front the deliberation loop yet.
- Tests: 440+ root and 1,450+ kernel tests in CI.
- Known limits: in the Claude Desktop run the synthesizer dropped some of the reviewer's hedges; the reviewer critiques against its own counterargument.
- Source: https://github.com/verdaca/VERDACA

## WIP (designed, not built)

- Teams / Slack channels (adapters tested against recorded traffic only), plug-in personas, workflow recipes, Verdaca Studio deliberation, an installable `verdaca` package
- OpenAI ↔ Anthropic and Forge ↔ Caveman swaps (one adapter each, not swap-tested)
- Signed receipts, human sign-off in the receipt, a separate critic
- Quality figures: the earlier +47% / +21% numbers are self-graded (one session, N=10) and are not evidence
